chooseResponse.q: What did you think of the event?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Did you attend the poetry reading last night?
Advisor: Yes, I thought it was amazing. The featured poet was really talented.
Student: I heard that too! What was your favorite part?
Advisor: I loved the way they interpreted nature in their poems.

talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of supply and demand in economics. Supply refers to how much of a product or service is available, while demand refers to how much of that product or service people want. When supply exceeds demand, prices tend to fall, whereas when demand exceeds supply, prices tend to rise. This relationship is fundamental to understanding market dynamics and can affect everything from local businesses to global economies.

questions.q: What does supply refer to in economics?
questions.explain: 供應在經濟學中指的是產品或服務的可獲得性。

questions.q: What happens when supply exceeds demand?
questions.explain: 當供應超過需求時，價格通常會下降。

questions.q: What is demand in economic terms?
questions.explain: 需求在經濟學中指的是人們對產品的需求。

questions.q: Why is the concept of supply and demand important?
questions.explain: 供需概念對市場動態的影響非常重要。
